duplicate_groups: connected components of exact row matches in the union of training embeddings A/B/C

calibration.cv: explicit StratifiedGroupKFold 3-way splits within each inner-training partition
calibration.selection_score: lower pooled inner-heldout Brier score; raw on exact tie
calibration.exclusion: each inner-heldout row is excluded from both base-model fitting and calibration fitting

recall_first.objective: minimum false positives among feasible thresholds

thresholds.tie_break: higher relevant recall, higher precision, then higher threshold where applicable

baselines.fixed_logistic_regression: each A/B/C, raw vectors, C=1, class_weight=None, max_iter=3000, threshold=0.5
baselines.llm: frozen supplied training predictions joined by query_id

blind_test: loaded only after final all-training inner development selection and threshold freeze; no test labels are available
assumptions: 98% relevant recall and 99% Medical recall are illustrative development targets, not assignment requirements or safety guarantees
